findings.title: Alabama Medicaid Agency Administrative Code Chapter 560-X-6 Physicians' Program
findings.quote: Except for those services which require prior approval as stated in Chapters 1 and 6 of this Administrative Code (i.e. transplants and select surgeries)
findings.note: Governing physician-program rule chapter (incl. 560-X-6-.13/.14 medical-necessity and prior-approval provisions). The deeper Provider Billing Manual Ch.28 Physician (medicaid.alabama.gov/content/Gated/7.6.1G_Provider_Manuals/7.6.1.1G_Jan_2026/Jan26_28.pdf) exists but medicaid.alabama.gov failed TLS verification from our fetcher on 2026-08-19 and could not be confirmed. AL is largely FFS; no ortho-specific criteria published.

findings.title: Provider Manual, Alaska Medicaid - Health Care Services (Comagine Health, state UR contractor)
findings.quote: Evaluation of the medical necessity, appropriateness, and efficiency of the use of healthcare services, procedures, and facilities
findings.note: Utilization review manual governing Alaska Medicaid pre-service (prior authorization), concurrent and retrospective review of inpatient surgical admissions and outpatient imaging (Appendix A). Alaska is FFS; state SA page health.alaska.gov/en/education/service-authorizations/ points to this UR process. No ortho-procedure-specific criteria published.

findings.title: AHCCCS Medical Policy Manual (AMPM) 820 - Fee-For-Service Prior Authorization Requirements
findings.quote: An Authorization is required for the following inpatient and outpatient hospital services for all FFS and DDD THP members: a. Elective inpatient admissions, b. Elective and urgent outpatient surgical procedures
findings.note: Deep FFS PA chapter of the AMPM; covers all elective ortho surgery generically, no procedure-specific criteria. Most members are in ACC managed-care plans that apply their own UM criteria.

findings.title: AFMC Review Services - Prior Authorization (Arkansas Medicaid surgical PA)
findings.quote: Arkansas Medicaid requires that some surgical procedures be authorized by AFMC prior to the performance of the procedure.
findings.note: AFMC is the state UR vendor; governing list is Physician manual Section II 262.000 'Procedures That Require Prior Authorization' (current file only as .doc: humanservices.arkansas.gov/wp-content/uploads/PHYSICN-3-22up.doc). Verified 2009 register filing of 262.000 (sos.arkansas.gov/uploads/rulesRegs/Arkansas%20Register/2009/oct_2009/016.06.09-036.pdf) lists PA CPTs - none of the 12 tracked ortho CPTs (27447, 27130, 22612, etc.) were on the FFS PA list.

findings.title: Manual of Criteria for Medi-Cal Authorization
findings.quote: Fresh fractures of the femoral neck in the older age group, senile, or patients otherwise judged not appropriate for internal fixation
findings.note: Section 5.1.3 MUSCULOSKELETAL contains TAR medical-necessity criteria for Hip Arthroplasty (quote above is a hip arthroplasty indication), Lumbar Disc Surgery, Meniscectomy, and Recurrent Shoulder Dislocation Surgery. Old (2004) but still the DHCS-posted criteria manual for FFS TARs; most members are in managed-care plans using InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: General Provider Information Manual - FFS Prior Authorization Requirements section
findings.quote: Under FFS reimbursement, the Health First Colorado program prior authorizes: - Expensive services such as transplantation and long-term care.
findings.note: PA section of the master provider manual (also flags 'Procedures where inappropriate utilization has been reported' and cosmetic-capable procedures). ColoradoPAR UM program (hcpf.colorado.gov/par) is run by Acentra for 'select outpatient benefits, services, supplies, out-of-state inpatient hospital services, IHT, and select PADs' - no routine ortho-surgery review category and no published ortho criteria.

findings.title: HUSKY Health - Submission of Prior Authorization (PA) Requests for Medical Goods and Services
findings.quote: All outpatient surgical procedures as determined by the Physician Surgical Fee Schedule require prior authorization
findings.note: CT is single FFS/ASO (CHNCT). Companion Outpatient Surgery PA Quick Reference Guide (huskyhealthct.org/providers/provider_postings/prior_auth/OP-Surgery_Quick_Reference_Guide.pdf, verified) confirms InterQual evidence-based criteria are applied. HUSKY's public clinical-policy list has no policies for the 12 tracked ortho CPTs.

findings.title: Delaware Medical Assistance Program (DMAP) Practitioner Provider Specific Policy Manual
findings.quote: The DMAP does not require prior authorization for medically necessary surgeries (excluding transplants and bariatric surgeries).
findings.note: FFS manual chapter: no PA for medically necessary ortho surgery in FFS. Nearly all members are in Diamond State Health Plan MCOs (AmeriHealth Caritas DE, Highmark) which must be used for practitioner services and apply their own InterQual/MCG-based PA - state delegates ortho PA to MCOs.

findings.title: Florida Medicaid Orthopedic Services Coverage Policy (Rule 59G-4.211, F.A.C.)
findings.quote: Providers must obtain authorization for orthopedic services from the quality improvement organization when specified on the applicable Florida Medicaid fee schedule(s).
findings.note: Surgery/musculoskeletal-specific coverage policy: arthrodesis, osteotomy, spinal instrumentation, surgery of the musculoskeletal system/spine/back, fractures, vertebroplasty. PA per 59G-1.053 and the fee schedule; SMMC plans administer PA for their enrollees.

findings.title: GAMMIS - All Policy Manuals (Part II Policies and Procedures for Physician Services)
findings.note: GAMMIS policy-manuals page returns 'An Application Error has Occured' (re-verified 2026-08-19) and no working mirror of the Part II Physician Services manual was found (dch.georgia.gov hosts only RHC/FQHC/Hospice Part II manuals; guessed physician slugs 404; GAMMIS ResourceProxy links time out). Static GAMMIS content (e.g., DMA-610 PA form PDF) does load, confirming a FFS prior-approval program; most members are in Georgia Families CMOs that run their own PA.

findings.title: Hawaii Medicaid Provider Manual - Chapter 6: Medical/Surgical Services
findings.quote: Authorization is required for certain surgical procedures.
findings.note: FFS surgical-services chapter of the Med-QUEST provider manual; gives categories (cosmetic-capable, certain elective procedures) but no comprehensive code list - fiscal agent holds the full list. Most members are in QUEST Integration MCOs applying InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: Idaho Medicaid Provider Handbook - Medical Services
findings.quote: reviews prior authorization (PA) requests for some services and surgical procedures as listed on the Numerical Fee Schedule or when a prior authorization would otherwise be indicated
findings.note: Physician/medical services module of the Idaho Medicaid Provider Handbook; Section 7 'Prior Authorization' (p.127) and Section 1.4 (Telligen, the state UM contractor, subject of the quote). PA-required surgical codes are flagged on the Numerical Fee Schedule. Idaho is largely FFS.

findings.title: HFS Handbook for Practitioners Rendering Medical Services (Chapter 200 policy)
findings.quote: Surgical procedures are allowable when they are medically necessary, recognized as standard medical care and required for the immediate health and well-being because of illness, disability, infirmity or impairment.
findings.note: Topic 222 Surgery (incl. 222.7 'Coronary Artery Bypass Graft and Back Surgeries', 220.5.1 Second Surgical Opinion). HFS Medical Prior Approval Criteria (MPAC) page has no ortho criteria (bariatric/DME only). Most members in HealthChoice Illinois MCOs using InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: IHCP Provider Reference Module: Surgical Services (PROMOD00047, v7.0)
findings.quote: Prior authorization (PA) is required for all procedures outlined in Indiana Administrative Code 405 IAC 5-3-13.
findings.note: Surgery-specific provider-manual module; contains PA criteria for lumbar artificial disc, spinal cord stimulators, spinal stenosis devices, bilateral procedures. No detailed criteria for TKA/THA/rotator cuff - those follow 405 IAC 5-3-13 PA and, for most members, MCE (managed care) InterQual/MCG criteria.

findings.title: Iowa Administrative Code 441-78.1 - Physicians' services (surgical preprocedure review)
findings.quote: Preprocedure review by Iowa Medicaid will be required if payment under Medicaid is to be made for certain frequently performed surgical procedures that have a wide variation in the relative frequency the procedures are performed.
findings.note: Governing FFS rule for surgical preprocedure (prior) review. Iowa HHS PA page (hhs.iowa.gov/medicaid/provider-services/covered-services-rates-and-payments/prior-authorization, verified) hosts PA forms incl. radiology but no comprehensive criteria list. Most members are in IA Health Link MCOs (Iowa Total Care, Molina, Wellpoint) applying InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: KMAP Provider Manuals (General Benefits / Professional FFS manuals)
findings.note: Verified 2026-08-19: the manuals page AND direct manual PDF URLs (e.g., portal.kmap-state-ks.us/Documents/Provider/Provider%20Manuals/GenBenefits_25081_25086.pdf) both 302-redirect to user.kmap-state-ks.us/oam/server/obrareq.cgi (Oracle Access Manager login). No current public mirror found (a KDHE DocumentCenter copy is a 2020 partial excerpt). Nearly all members are in KanCare MCOs (Aetna, Sunflower, Healthy Blue) applying InterQual/MCG.

findings.title: 907 KAR 3:005 - Coverage of physicians' services (Section 5: services requiring prior authorization)
findings.quote: A surgical procedure that requires completion of a federal consent form.
findings.note: Governing FFS physician-services rule; Section 5(1) lists the services requiring prior authorization (quote is item (m), one of the listed surgical PA triggers). FFS PA is processed by Gainwell per kymmis.com Prior Authorizations page (verified: 'All Prior Authorization (PA) requests for Fee-for-Service ... are processed by Gainwell Technologies'). Most members are in MCOs using InterQual/MCG. PT64-65 physician billing-instruction PDF links currently 404 on kymmis.com.
